targets.expr:
max by (pod, namespace) (
  (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull"} * 3)
  or (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", phase="Succeeded"} * 5)
  or (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", phase="Unknown"} * 3)
  or (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", phase="Failed"} * 4)
  or (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", phase="Pending"} * 2)
  or (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", phase="Running"} * 1)
)

sum( gpu:resource:gpu_temp * on(UUID, GPU_I_ID) group_left(exported_pod, exported_namespace, exported_container) sgn(MIG_POD_ALLOCATED{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"$deployment.*"})) by (exported_pod, modelName, gpu, GPU_I_PROFILE)

sum( gpu:resource:power * on(UUID, GPU_I_ID) group_left(exported_pod, exported_namespace, exported_container) sgn(MIG_POD_ALLOCATED{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"$deployment.*"})) by (exported_pod, modelName, gpu, GPU_I_PROFILE) * 7

sum( gpu:resource:sm_active * on(UUID, GPU_I_ID) group_left(exported_pod, exported_namespace, exported_container) sgn(MIG_POD_ALLOCATED{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"$deployment.*"})) by (exported_pod, modelName, gpu, GPU_I_PROFILE)

sum(  gpu:resource:tensor_core  * on(UUID, GPU_I_ID) group_left(exported_pod, exported_namespace, exported_container) sgn(MIG_POD_ALLOCATED{exported_namespace="$namespace", exported_pod=~"$deployment.*"})) by (exported_pod, modelName, gpu, GPU_I_PROFILE)
